entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: This is an application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 26.9.2023 in connection with Crime No. 270/2023, registered at Police Station Tala District Satna for the offence punishable under Sections 376 and 454 of the IPC.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case of rape.
It is submitted that incident occurred on 18.9.2023 and report has been lodged on 25.9.2023 after delay.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3 . Learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the bail application and submitted that as per 164 Cr.P.C. statement applicant has forcefully committed rape on the prosecutrix.

sentences.text: 4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5. Prosecutrix is a major aged about 21 years.
There is delay in lodging of FIR and same has not been properly explained by the prosecution.
6 . Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.

8. In addition to that the applicant shall also abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437 (3)
of Cr. P. C..
Certified copy as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE AD/
